name: Paralyzed
summary: Incapacitated, Speed 0, fails Str and Dex saves; hits from within 5 ft are Critical Hits.
text: You have the Incapacitated condition and your Speed is 0 and can't increase. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and any attack that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
